Di Bari Eq. 14 charges 0.85e-3 MJ per m of roving = 1 s of robot time per m: 3600 m/h x 0.0057 kg/m = 20.5 kg/h. Max 123 kg/h = physical reading (6 rovings at 1.0 m/s = 6 m of roving per s); min 10.3 kg/h = robot at 0.5 m/s.
comments: Typical follows the paper's own energy model (the paper counts robot energy per metre of each roving, as if they were wound one at a time at 1 m/s). Physically, winding 6 rovings at once is 6x faster; that is the max. Compare lci_raw_cfw: 4.1 kg/h (1 roving, 0.2 m/s). Energy: 0.85/20.5 = 0.041 kWh/kg.
